machine: AMD Ryzen 5 6600H board, Realtek RTL8168 (10ec:8168) at 01:00.0, direct cable to the operator's Mac (10.77.0.1)

image.delivery: PXE from the Mac; the watchdog resets the board about every 90 s, so each boot is fresh

observations.result: KDBG records on UDP 7799 from the kernel (first seen 21:12, stage 1)
port 0x64 = 0x12: controller present, input buffer busy, no key data (USB keyboard not visible to the OS)
KDBG 0xc000, a new value each boot
KDBG 0xc003 for each; Itonami opened and its Goal reads aba
KDBG 0xc002, then a new boot nonce 11 s later

limits: Ed25519 only; the repository's post-quantum floor (ML-DSA-65 alongside) is not met by this diagnostic channel
opt-in debug entry only; no non-debug entry has a receive path
one RX descriptor, polled; frames arriving during a busy turn are dropped
